approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would repeal a 1991 law that charges fees for pathology approvals.
It would remove application fees for three types of approvals needed to provide Medicare-funded pathology services.
The government says the fees have not been changed since 1991 and exceed the cost of processing applications.
Removes application charges for approvals of pathology practitioners, authorities and laboratories.
Aligns the charging arrangement with the Australian Government's Charging Framework.
Pathology providers who apply for approvals to be listed as Medicare service providers.
